newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq stocks close slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq stocks close slightly higher.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks recovered from two consecutive down days to close slightly higher on Friday.
The Nasdaq Composite Index was up 0.53 points, or 0.04 percent, at 1242.49 at its unofficial close while declines led advancing issues by 2026 to 2006 on volume of about 569 million shares.
Phil Roth, technical analyst at Dean Witter Reynolds, said that Nasdaq's weakness over the last few days was a function of softness in the major high tech stocks which have become overextended.

"They are consolidating," he said. "There is nothing surprising about this. We are in the late part of an up cycle and advances always narrow. I am not expecting the second tier (stocks) to catch up. Whatever room is left on the upside will be occupied by mark-ups in blue chips."
Among today's special situations, shares of Iomega Corp rose 1-3/16 to 24-1/16 after reporting better than forecast third quarter earnings.
Vantive Corp fell 9-1/2 to 31-1/4 after the company told analysts it expects revenue growth to be flat in the next two quarters.
